sites.rationale: CLEC4A is a type II transmembrane protein: residues 1–46 are intracellular, 47–67 span the membrane, and 68–237 are extracellular. The C-terminus (residue 237, L) is therefore the sole extracellular terminus, making it the unique landing site for the reported C-terminal FLAG tag. No residue number is named in the paper, so position_evidence is topology_derived; the junction is computed as insert_after_residue=237. The tag site is 170 residues from the TM boundary, well beyond the ≥3-residue minimum. Python confirmed residue 237 = L and residue 236 = H from the numbered sequence. Full-length human DCIR (CLEC4A) cloned into the EMCV-SRα vector with a C-terminal (extracellular) FLAG epitope tag; membrane-anchored construct expressed in cells. The coding region NM016184 bases 263–974 encodes exactly 237 codons, confirming the full-length 237 aa protein. The paper explicitly labels the tag '(extracellular)', consistent with CLEC4A's type II topology in which the C-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus.

sources.claim: Full‐length open‐reading frames of human Mincle (NM014358, bases 109‐766), DCIR (NM016184, bases 263‐974), or Dectin‐2 (NM001007033, bases 151‐778) were cloned in to the EMCV‐SRα vector followed by a C‐terminal (extracellular) FLAG epitope tag.

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) was provided. It reports a full-length, membrane-anchored CLEC4A construct with a C-terminal (extracellular) FLAG tag — satisfying all inclusion criteria (full-length, membrane-anchored, extracellular face, tolerated). The paper does not name a specific residue number, but CLEC4A's type II topology leaves exactly one extracellular terminus (C-terminus, residue 237), so the position is topology-derived rather than validated. No internal loop insertions, N-terminal tags, or function-abrogating positions are reported in the ledger.
